contact.title: Contact
contact.message: Reach out to the team for more information.

login.tagline: Login with your registered email & password.
login.error_message: Unable to sign in. Check your email and password.

register.title: Create your account
register.tagline: Share a few details to start exploring Info Navi.
register.name: Full name
register.alert_tagline: Please double-check your information before submitting.
register.success_message: Signup successful. Check your email for the verification code.
register.error_message: We couldn't complete your signup. Please try again.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.tagline: Enter your registered email and we'll send a reset link.
forgot.alert_tagline: If the email is valid, you'll receive password reset instructions shortly.
forgot.success_message: Password reset code sent. Check your email.
forgot.error_message: We couldn't send the reset email. Please try again.

confirm_email.title: Verify your email
confirm_email.tagline: Paste the code we emailed you to complete registration.
confirm_email.resend_prompt: Didn't receive the OTP code? Try again.
confirm_email.resend_success: A new verification code has been sent. Check your email inbox.
confirm_email.success_message: Email verified successfully. You can log in now.
confirm_email.error_message: Verification failed. Check the code and try again.
confirm_email.registration_notice: Account created successfully. Please check your email for the verification code and confirm your account.

forgot_confirm.title: Set a new password
forgot_confirm.tagline: Enter the reset code from your email along with a new password.
forgot_confirm.success_message: Password reset successfully. You can log in with the new password.
forgot_confirm.error_message: We couldn't reset your password. Please recheck the code.

profile.info_subtitle: Fetched directly from the authentication service.
